questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Iinyathi or Kei?
Yolandi Potgieter set a database record (combined T20 + List A) with a value of 80. Which record is it?
options: Best Bowling Figures in an Innings
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Catches (Fielding)', held by Yolandi Potgieter.

questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2012/10/13.

questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?

questions.question: Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.
